subject: SPU Synth standard VAB and supplemental JSON bank/Tone presets

scope.bank: Exact original combined VAB; split VH/VB concatenated. Available Tones also saved as supplemental portable JSON.
scope.selectedTone: One Program / one Tone / one Sample standard VAB plus JSON. Original Program ID retained; packed Tone 0 / Sample 1.
scope.attributes: Original header/master, Program/Tone raw attributes, ADPCM, body prefix and bounded sample padding. No decode/re-encode.
scope.presetPicker: Standard VAB Program/Tone entries first, SPU JSON separately. VAB does not require saved JSON. Explicit selection only, Keyboard/Code mode kept.
scope.saveOwnership: No AudioContext initialization, SPU RAM upload, sample assignment, gate, Code stop or PSF playback/paused-position change during direct bank saves.
scope.atomic: NFC/case-insensitive filename collisions avoided; standard VAB + JSON committed together only after full 16 MiB project-capacity validation.
scope.jsonSettings: Shared authored reverb snapshot at save time, PMON/Noise/Morph Off for direct Tone copies; VAB uses current shared reverb when selected.
scope.publicApi: Browser module readVab/prepareVabTone/exportVab reusable with normal SPU loadADPCM/setPreset. Parser not yet an npm export. Existing Synth Code can play a selected VAB Tone.

checks: Opening and saving every usable VAB Tone creates portable presets without initializing audio
Repeated bank and selected-Tone saves use new paths and retain every existing JSON byte
Unavailable Tones are skipped with their explicit reason, and reimporting the original bank remains lossless
Bank and Tone saves preserve the authored Sine, Software morph and its sustained actual voice
The explicit saved-preset picker loads and reloads the correct sample, ADSR, tuning and loop without leaving Keyboard
Saving the retained bank during PSF Play and Pause keeps the song source and authored sound
Bank-save controls and the saved-preset picker fit 390px without horizontal overflow
Saved preset choices restore without audio or automatic instrument execution
A project containing only a standard VAB supports direct Tone presets without intermediate JSON

visualInspection.result: Bank/Tone save buttons and Preset field readable and inside viewport; no overlapping controls. Native select internal overflow confined to its label with an inset focus outline.

distribution.runtimeSource: source-copy; authored JavaScript and CSS remain readable, no minification or bundling

limits: Source-preserving VAB bank / selected original Tone export only. Arbitrary edited Synth instruments still save as JSON.
VAB cannot retain shared reverb, PMON pairing, Noise clock or software Morph endpoints.
Unavailable Tones are preserved in complete VAB but skipped for JSON and playable Preset choices.
No real-game listening test or npm publication in this task.
